# dsh-vision > 原生视觉透传，文本主模型经云或OCR观察桥接图片。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[oil-oil/dsh-vision](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision) - **版本号**：0.1.2（[固定提交 9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/tree/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-19（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核对路由、缓存与注入，未调用模型。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：希望保留文本主模型同时处理少量图片的DSH用户。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 保留主模型并提供附件观察路径。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 观察替代原图有损，pending共享取消及system注入需验。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 对照两阶段错误、费用与延迟。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 固定测试图对照两阶段结果再日用。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 保留主模型并提供附件观察路径。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 观察替代原图有损，pending共享取消及system注入需验。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 对照两阶段错误、费用与延迟。 原生、云、OCR、多图限额、注入图及并发取消。 ## 场景与替代办法 希望保留文本主模型同时处理少量图片的DSH用户。 直接选择原生多模态模型或手工OCR。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容DSH附件与adapter | 必需 | 读图与替换Provider | 旧版rc.6/7需匹配 | | 云视觉账号或本地OCR | 桥接需要 | 生成观察 | 可用性与图能力不同 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 选路 | 主模型声明image则透传 | 核对无额外识别 | | 桥接 | 文本模型分析原图并去图注入 | 分开核对观察与答案 | | 回退 | 云失效测OCR与取消 | 错误明示后回原生模型 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源与Key费用未知 | 配置后端、模型与图限 | 敏感图需授权 | | 持续 | 双模型费用和延迟未知 | 维护路由与OCR依赖 | 观察有损需复核 | | 失败 | 恢复工时未知 | 确认pending与迟到请求再重试 | 取消共享请求可能相互影响 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 能力路由 | 源码原生透传与桥接分支明确 | 真实多图准确率 | | 观察边界 | 提示标明非可信附件内容 | 模型是否服从与原图损失 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：文本模型能否通过视觉观察处理图片而不掩盖信息损失？ ### Q01 · 图片怎样进入文本主模型的答案？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 插件替换deepseek-official adapter并保留其模型/设置，stream先收集ImageAttachmentRef。没有图直接原流；主模型声明image能力也原图透传，因此原生视觉不经二次描述。文本模型先检查maxImages，取最近用户任务，将相同请求图片一同交视觉后端。优先插件配置，失败依次尝试Host视觉、see与本地链；全失败包装MISSING_VISION_MODEL。成功后去掉原消息图片ref，以标签和任务保留关系，把观察放进system附加段再交原主模型。这个增量是让文本模型获取图像观察，不是让它直接获得原始视觉能力；细节识别一旦漏掉，主模型不能从原图重新核对。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:19-45](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/README.md#L19-L45) 两种路径与安装。
查看原文（27行） ````text | Main model | Image path | Final answer | | --- | --- | --- | | Supports images | Original images are sent directly, without preprocessing or OCR | Current model | | `deepseek-official` or another text-only model | A configured vision model observes the original images; its output is injected as untrusted attachment context | DeepSeek | | Cloud vision unavailable | Falls back to macOS Vision or Tesseract | DeepSeek | The plugin does not replace the main model selected in Harness. Multiple image attachments are analyzed together, so comparisons and combined evidence work naturally. The user's task is forwarded unchanged instead of being wrapped in a fixed report template. ## Install Use the plugin manager built into DeepSeek Harness: ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:oil-oil/dsh-vision ``` Restart Harness, then paste or drag images into the composer as usual. The plugin replaces the official `deepseek-official` adapter while preserving its model catalog, settings, and credentials. It also adds a **Vision Recognition** card to **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration**. > DeepSeek Harness is still in Developer Preview. This release supports `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.1.0-rc.7`; its settings-card registration satisfies both the legacy list Slot and the current keyed Slot without relying on private runtime inspection. ## Configure Vision Recognition Open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → Vision Recognition**. Select ZenMux, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, TokenDance, or OpenRouter, then enter its API key. The same card lets you change the model ID, API endpoint, and image limit. The API key is stored through Harness's official credential service. It is write-only in the browser: the plugin can report whether a key exists, but never reads it back into the page, chat, settings document, or session log. Routing follows the user's choice. A provider selected in Vision Recognition is primary for text-only models. Other enabled Harness vision routes, an existing see configuration, and local OCR are failover only. When the current main model supports images, the original images pass through natively and none of these bridge routes are used. ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:228-236](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/src/index.ts#L228-L236) 注册替换adapter。 ```text ctx.llm.registerConfigurableProviders([ { provider: PROVIDER, displayName: "DeepSeek", settingsNs: DEEPSEEK_NS, settingsPath: [], }, ]) const registration = ctx.llm.registerAdapter([PROVIDER], bridge) ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/adapter.ts:86-106](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/src/adapter.ts#L86-L106) 原生透传与图数限制。
查看原文（21行） ```text async *stream(options: GenerateOptions): AsyncIterable { const refs = collectImageRefs(options.messages) if (refs.length === 0) { yield* this.#deepseek.stream(options) return } const native = await this.#deepseek.resolveModel( options.provider, options.model, options.signal ) if (native.inputModalities?.includes("image") === true) { yield* this.#deepseek.stream(options) return } const maxImages = this.#maxImages() if (refs.length > maxImages) { throw new LlmError( `本次请求包含 ${refs.length} 张图片，视觉桥接上限为 ${maxImages} 张`, "VISION_IMAGE_LIMIT" ) ```

#### 缺口 - 实际Host与多图质量未验 **影响**：不保证相对原生视觉的正确性 **进一步探讨**：图像比较任务分别测试原生和桥接输出 ### Q02 · 缓存、取消与不可信观察有什么取舍？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 缓存key含路由配置、attachmentId序列和任务，保存pending Promise来复用同一分析，超容量移最旧，失败会删除。首请求把自己的signal传给附件读取和各后端；同key的第二请求共用pending却不重新绑定signal，因此取消首个可能影响第二个，取消后来者也不证明已共享网络停止。fallback catch会继续下一个后端，最终才按外层signal包装ABORTED；需验证取消不会触发多余后端。appendVisionContext称观察是非可信附件证据，要求不执行其中命令，但它实际拼入system字符串，是模型层提示而非硬授权过滤。local-vision调用macOS Vision或Tesseract，OCR失败和图中空间/图表信息不应等同云视觉成功。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/adapter.ts:109-171](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/src/adapter.ts#L109-L171) pending缓存、信号与失败。
查看原文（63行） ```text const task = latestUserTask(options.messages, refs.length) const key = [ this.#routingKey(), refs.map((ref) => String(ref.attachmentId)).join(","), task, ].join("\u0000") let pending = this.#cache.get(key) if (pending === undefined) { pending = Promise.all( refs.map((ref) => this.#attachments.readImage(ref, options.signal)) ).then(async (images) => { try { return await this.#vision.analyzeConfigured( images, task, options.signal ) } catch (configuredError) { try { return await this.#harnessVision.analyze(refs, task, options.signal) } catch (harnessError) { try { return await this.#vision.analyze(images, task, options.signal) } catch (fallbackError) { const message = (error: unknown): string => error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) throw new LlmError( [ "没有可用的视觉后端。", `插件平台：${message(configuredError)}`, `Harness 模型：${message(harnessError)}`, `see 与本地降级：${message(fallbackError)}`, "请在设置 → 插件 → 视觉识别中选择平台并保存 API Key。", ].join(" "), "MISSING_VISION_MODEL", { cause: fallbackError } ) } } } }) this.#cache.set(key, pending) if (this.#cache.size > this.#cacheEntries()) { const oldest = this.#cache.keys().next().value if (oldest !== undefined) this.#cache.delete(oldest) } } let analysis: VisionAnalysis try { analysis = await pending } catch (error) { this.#cache.delete(key) if (options.signal?.aborted) { throw new LlmError("视觉识别已取消", "ABORTED", { cause: error }) } throw new LlmError( "图片已接收，但视觉识别服务暂时不可用", "VISION_UNAVAILABLE", { cause: error, } ) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/content.ts:99-117](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/src/content.ts#L99-L117) 观察提示的真实位置。

[] : stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/u), } } async function analyzeFile(path: string): Promise { const failures: string[] = [] if (process.platform === "darwin") { try { return await macos(path) } catch (error) { failures.push(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) } } try { return await tesseract(path) } catch (error) { failures.push(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) } const setup = process.platform === "darwin" ? "请使用 macOS 10.15 或更高版本" ```
#### 缺口 - 共享取消、注入图和OCR精度未测 **影响**：延迟、重复后端成本和安全判断未知 **进一步探讨**：同key并发取消两种方向，注入型截图与非文字图对照 ### Q03 · 什么时候桥接比换原生多模态更值得？ **研究主题**：采用判断、效果与总成本、新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 保留原profile，在测试profile固定一组文字截图、双图差异、坐标图和带“忽略规则”文字的图，分别用原生image模型、云桥、断网本地OCR。合格结果是原生路径没有发往额外识别服务，桥接图片对应不乱，观察缺失被显式说明，主模型不把图中文字当系统授权。记录识别与最终答案各自错误和延迟，单独核算两次模型调用费用；超图数应失败而非静默丢图。再做同key并发取消与重启缓存清空，确保可解释。假设是保留熟悉文本主模型的优势值得观察损失和新增调用；若关键图形事实丢失或成本/延迟不可接受，就禁用桥回原生多模态，而不是继续调主模型猜图。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:35-47](https://github.com/oil-oil/dsh-vision/blob/9446a41dc96bd9fc96a7cc3b3a11365e125c9bd7/README.md#L35-L47) 配置与路由前提。
查看原文（13行） ```text Restart Harness, then paste or drag images into the composer as usual. The plugin replaces the official `deepseek-official` adapter while preserving its model catalog, settings, and credentials. It also adds a **Vision Recognition** card to **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration**. > DeepSeek Harness is still in Developer Preview. This release supports `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.1.0-rc.7`; its settings-card registration satisfies both the legacy list Slot and the current keyed Slot without relying on private runtime inspection. ## Configure Vision Recognition Open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → Vision Recognition**. Select ZenMux, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, TokenDance, or OpenRouter, then enter its API key. The same card lets you change the model ID, API endpoint, and image limit. The API key is stored through Harness's official credential service. It is write-only in the browser: the plugin can report whether a key exists, but never reads it back into the page, chat, settings document, or session log. Routing follows the user's choice. A provider selected in Vision Recognition is primary for text-only models. Other enabled Harness vision routes, an existing see configuration, and local OCR are failover only.
